headlines.title: Jensen Huang back at Nvidia, stock soars; Anthropic slides
headlines.snippet: The 8:30 team is joined by Roundhill Investments Chief Investment Strategist Drew Pettit to discuss why washed-out sentiment doesn't mean a fundamental bottom, his $50-to-$250 bull-bear range on Anthropic, and how to handicap the "Jensen premium" coming back into Nvidia. Deirdre Bosa Live host Deirdre Bosa also joins to break down Silicon Valley's reaction to Huang's return and what it means for the AI trade.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang back as Nvidia CEO after 12 days: Shares surge 30%
headlines.snippet:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down the stunning news of the morning: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstating founder Jensen Huang as CEO just 12 days after his resignation. Including his five takeaways on what the reversal says about corporate governance, the role Washington played in the decision, and the rally that's lifting the whole AI trade while sending AMD lower.

Brian is joined by New Street Research technology infrastructure analyst Antoine Chkaiban on the new checks around Huang and why he's still a buyer; "In the Loop" host Ejaz on key-man risk and whether the "Bank of Nvidia" reopens for neoclouds; EMJ Capital founder and president Eric Jackson, who calls the return a win for open-source AI; Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman on the board's credibility and Colette Kress's future; Moor Insights & Strategy founder and chief analyst Patrick Moorhead on the politics behind the ouster and why nothing changes for AMD for 18 months; and SlateStone Wealth partner and chief market strategist Kenny Polcari on whether this kicks off a year-end rally.
